scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build --workspace @amos/console
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/engine/*.test.js dist/storage/*.test.js dist/adapters/*/*.test.js dist/decision/*.test.js dist/supervisor/*.test.js dist/guidance/*.test.js dist/injector/*.test.js dist/activation/*.test.js dist/catalog/*.test.js dist/workflow/*.test.js dist/review/*.test.js dist/host/*.test.js dist/check/*.test.js dist/rollout/*.test.js dist/managed/*.test.js dist/strict/*.test.js dist/autonomy/*.test.js dist/control-plane/*.test.js && npm test --workspace @amos/console
scripts.console: npm run build && node dist/control-plane/cli.js serve
scripts.console:init: npm run build && node dist/control-plane/cli.js init
